humor: Self-deprecating: admits to having way too many unfinished side projects, and the absurdity of actually counting them

text: Diğer 99 şeyi bitirmek yerine bunu yaptım.
original: Built instead of finishing the other 99 things on my list.
humor: Self-deprecating: procrastinated on responsibilities by building yet another thing

text: Başka bir gün, başka bir alan adı satın alma.
humor: Developer stereotype: buying domains for projects that never get built. The casualness implies this is a regular occurrence.

text: Bunu kesinlikle bitireceğim. (Her seferinde söylediğim gibi.)
original: I'll definitely finish this one. (I say, every time.)
humor: Self-aware lie: the parenthetical admits they say this about every project and never follow through

text: Claude'un uyumaya ihtiyacı olmadığı için ben de uykusuz kaldım.
original: Built at 3am because Claude doesn't need sleep and apparently neither do I.
humor: Sleep deprivation humor: AI doesn't sleep, human thinks they don't need to either (they do)

text: Uyku düzenim bu projenin hayata geçmesi için öldü.
original: My sleep schedule died so this could live.
humor: Dramatic sacrifice framing for something trivial (a website). Mock-heroic tone.
Lost track of time coding, deadpan 'worth it' suggests questionable priorities

text: Bilinçsizce çay ve hayatım hakkında soru işaretleri ile beslendim.
original: Fueled by mass amounts of tea and questionable life choices.
humor: Classic developer fuel joke, but 'questionable life choices' adds self-awareness

text: Claude kodu yazdı, ben PR'ları onayladım. İkimiz de kimin daha çok yaptığı konusunda inkardasız.
original: Claude wrote the code. I approved the PRs. We're both in denial about who did more.
humor: AI collaboration joke: unclear division of labor, both taking/avoiding credit

text: AI'ın değişken adlandırma konusunda yargılamadığı bir çift programlama yaptık.
original: Pair programmed with an AI that doesn't judge my variable names.
humor: Developers are self-conscious about naming things. AI is portrayed as non-judgmental partner.

text: AI ile çalışıp artık ben kopilot muyum diye sorguladım.
original: Built with Claude while questioning if I'm the copilot now.
humor: Role reversal: human is supposed to be in charge but AI might be doing the real work. Reference to GitHub Copilot.

text: Claude ve ben birbirimizin... fonksiyonlarını tamamladık.
original: Claude and I finished each other's... functions.
humor: Subverted rom-com trope ('finish each other's sentences') applied to coding. Sweet but nerdy.

text: Bu footer'a tıkladığınız için dopamin veriyorum.
original: This footer changes on click. You're welcome for the dopamine.
humor: Meta-humor about the interaction itself. Sarcastic 'you're welcome' for a tiny reward.

text: Daha çok tıklayın, bunlar için gereksiz çok emek harcadım.
original: Keep clicking. I put way too much effort into these.
humor: Breaking fourth wall, admitting disproportionate effort on a minor feature

original: You're still clicking? I respect the commitment.
humor: Acknowledging the user's persistence with mock-respect

original: Wow, you really have a footer fetish.
humor: Playfully calling out obsessive clicking behavior. Slightly edgy but harmless.
Gaming reference: fake achievement for clicking through all quips

text: Daha fazlası var ama kaç tane olduğunu söylemeyeceğim.
original: There are more. But I won't tell you how many.
humor: Teasing withholding of information to encourage more clicking

original: You've seen all of them. Just kidding, keep going.
humor: Fake-out: pretends to end the game, then reveals there's more. Playful misdirection.
